settings.title: Your Vertex warranty
settings.text: Register your decking or cladding with your order number and photos of the installation. It only takes a few minutes, and it makes any future claim far simpler.
settings.usp_4: Your statutory rights are not affected

settings.title: Photograph as you build
settings.text: Take photos of the frame, joists, pedestals and fixings before the boards cover them, then of the finished deck or wall.

settings.title: Register online
settings.text: Add your details, your order number and the products you used, then email us your photos.

settings.title: Get your reference
settings.text: We check your photos and email your warranty reference, with your start and expiry dates, within [TIMEFRAME].

settings.title: Three steps to register
settings.text: The most important part happens before you finish: photograph the frame while you can still see it.

settings.text: We can’t register a warranty without them. Take them as you go: once the boards are down, nobody can see the frame underneath.
settings.note: Email your photos to [WARRANTY EMAIL] with your name, order number and installation address.

settings.note: Exclusions, remedies and limits are set out in the full warranty terms supplied with your order. Nothing in the warranty affects your statutory rights.

settings.title: Making a claim
settings.text: Spotted a problem? Contact the warranty team and include the following, so we can look into it quickly.
settings.items:
Proof of purchase or your invoice
Product details and batch reference, where you have it
A description of the problem
Clear photos of the affected boards
The date you first noticed the issue
Your installation photos, if we ask for them

settings.q: Do I have to register my warranty?
settings.a: Yes. We register your warranty once we have your details and all three sets of installation photos. [CONFIRM: any deadline for registering, for example within a set number of days of installation]

settings.q: I didn’t take photos while installing. What now?
settings.a: Get in touch with the warranty team as soon as you can. Missing photos may delay registration, or the assessment of a future claim, subject to the warranty terms and your statutory rights.

settings.q: How long does the warranty last?
settings.a: [WARRANTY PERIOD BY PRODUCT]. Your start and expiry dates appear on your registration confirmation, along with your warranty reference.

settings.q: My deck was fitted by a contractor. Can I still register?
settings.a: [ANSWER: who can register, and how contractor installs are handled]

settings.q: Where do I find the batch reference?
settings.a: [ANSWER: where the batch or product reference is printed on boards or packaging]

settings.q: Does the warranty affect my statutory rights?
settings.a: No. The warranty is in addition to your statutory rights, not instead of them.
